name: WorldNet
description: WorldNet is a multimodal state transition prediction benchmark designed to evaluate the capability of models to understand and predict dynamics in complex real-life scenarios. It supports evaluation of multimodal large language models like WorldGPT in modeling state transitions across diverse domains.
reputation: A recent research benchmark with limited but growing visibility, mainly used in papers on multimodal world modeling rather than as a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: Benchmark covers varied real-life scenarios; used to demonstrate WorldGPT's effectiveness in multimodal world modeling.
